page: Microsoft Azure M208ms_v2 is a memory-optimized server belonging to the MSv2 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 208 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 104 physical Intel Xeon 8280L cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The processor architecture is x86_64 and includes 105 MB of L3 cache, along with support for AVX-512 and AVX512_VNNI vector extensions. The system is equipped with 5700.0 GB of RAM, providing approximately 27.4 GB of memory per core, and includes 4194 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

In benchmark evaluations, the M208ms_v2 demonstrates highly polarized performance characteristics. Multi-core processing and memory bandwidth are exceptional, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and cached small-block read-only memory bandwidth ranking in the top tier. Conversely, single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by bottom-quartile scores in single-core stress-ng, single-threaded gzip compression, and single-core Geekbench tests. Large-block memory read and write speeds remain strong, alongside high throughput for static web serving and software compilation.

Given its massive memory footprint of nearly 5.7 TB and high multi-core density, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive resource consolidation rather than raw single-threaded speed. It is highly suited for large-scale in-memory databases, as supported by top-tier Redis SET operations, as well as enterprise database management systems, heavy multi-threaded data processing, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
